messages:
Samir Patel: FYI, running a joint channel POC with EdgeCloud (Acme account) next week. Need to align on architecture, KMS, and the security questionnaire responses.
Laura Chen: Thanks Samir — do we have a timeline from sales?
Samir Patel: Sales asked for a 2-week iteration: week1 demo + integration, week2 perf run. Kickoff Thurs.
Miguel Ortiz: Who owns the infra for the demo? Hosted Redwood or EdgeCloud-hosted? That affects pricing and SLA we quote.
John Hwang (EdgeCloud): We can host the POC in our VPC for the customer — they prefer private. EdgeCloud will provide network peering.
Priya Nair: If it's in their VPC, we need to confirm KMS/HSM integration and whether logs can be forwarded to their SIEM. I'll take security Qs.
Jordan Lee: I'll draft an architecture diagram. Quick question — do we support model pinning + canary rollouts in Private today?
Laura Chen: Yes, Private supports model pinning and canary via the control plane. We should call out latencies for tiny models vs larger ones.
Miguel Ortiz: Pricing: for a channel co-sell, do we use list pricing or a joint discounted reserved commit? Sales suggested a 6-month reserved with uplift for dedicated throughput.
Samir Patel: Sales wants a simple doc for the partner: two options — Hosted (usage-based) or Private (reserved monthly). Add example cost calc for 5M tokens/month.
John Hwang (EdgeCloud): Also need a short runbook for failback: if Private hits capacity, can app fall back to Redwood-hosted? Customer asks for graceful degradation.
Priya Nair: Security Q: edgecloud provided their auditor form. I'll fill E2E encryption, KMS details, and data retention. Pinging @deploy-bot for environment readiness.
deploy-bot: POC environment provision request received. Queue ID: #rd-edge-POC-472. Estimated ready in 18 hours.
Jordan Lee: Here's rough config snippet for the demo route, please review:
```
route: /api/generate
model: redwood-3b-q4
deployment: private-vpc-edgecloud
fallback: redwood-hosted-3b
timeout_ms: 2500
batching: auto
```
Miguel Ortiz: That looks good. Add `max_tokens` and `rate_limit_per_user` before we share publicly.
Laura Chen: I'll prepare the joint-deck for the kickoff: architecture slide + pricing table + security Q highlights. Target: slide deck done by Wed EOD.
Samir Patel: Action items: Priya -> security questionnaire + KMS details; Jordan -> arch diagram + config; Miguel -> pricing calc + rate-limit defaults; Laura -> partner deck; John -> confirm peering window Thurs morning.
John Hwang (EdgeCloud): Confirmed peering Thurs 09:00 PT. EdgeCloud will also run a quick network test prior to demo.
Priya Nair: Noted. Also flag: customer requires SOC2 section filled and BPM for data deletion. I'll attach the completed Q tomorrow.
Miguel Ortiz: One blocker I foresee: we may need Dedicated GPU for perf run to hit their latency SLO. If so, need procurement approval.
Samir Patel: Good call — Miguel, run a quick perf estimate. If Dedicated required, we'll escalate to Sales Ops for a short-term commit.
Jordan Lee: I'll add a small load test plan for the perf day. 50 concurrent sessions ramp to 300 over 10m.
Laura Chen: Great — everyone, please update the shared Notion page under Partnerships > EdgeCloud POCs so Sales and Partner AE can see progress.
Samir Patel: Thanks all — we'll sync again Wed standup for final prep. :thumbsup:
